spectrum.quality: A = 1 − R − T. Each wavelength is compared at multiple Fourier orders. This does not test grid resolution or uncertainty in measured material data.
spectrum.interpretation: Absorptance is approximately zero across the converged points, as expected for this lossless model. Inspect reflectance and transmittance features instead; R+T should be approximately one. A spectral peak alone does not identify a guided mode or bulk band gap.
